_readme: Queue for the weekly quiz-video pipeline (scripts/video-pipeline/weeklyRun.js), run by a local launchd job every Monday. Mirrors topic-queue.json's pattern for the blog pipeline. Status flow: ready -> published (uploaded to YouTube as private) -> live (taken public and embedded on the site via publishToSite.js). weeklyRun.js always picks the lowest-index 'ready' item. Only quizzes already in src/data/quizzes.json are queued here (en + es). Expanding to the other per-language quiz files (turkish-quizzes.json, ko-quizzes.json, vietnamese-quizzes.json, etc.) requires extending generateVideo.js's quiz lookup to search across files first — not done yet. Once a 'published' item is reviewed on YouTube, add cardTitle/cardDescription (and optionally embedHubSlug/embedBlogSlug) by hand, then run: node scripts/video-pipeline/publishToSite.js <quizId> --privacy public
